functions.name: UseHighPrecisionMouseMovement
functions.docs:
Enables the use of high precision (raw input) mouse movement, for more accurate mouse movement without mouse ballistics
NOTE: This implies mouse capture and hidden mouse movement.  Releasing mouse capture deactivates this mode.

functions.name: SetMousePos
functions.docs: An event should return FReply::Handled().SetMousePos to ask Slate to move the mouse cursor to a different location

functions.name: SetUserFocus
functions.signature: SetUserFocus(Target, Give Me Focus, Reason Focus Is Changing, In All Users)
functions.docs: An event should return FReply::Handled().SetUserFocus( SomeWidget ) as a means of asking the system to set users focus to the provided widget

functions.name: ClearUserFocus
functions.docs: An event should return a FReply::Handled().ClearUserFocus() to ask the system to clear user focus

functions.name: ClearUserFocus
functions.signature: ClearUserFocus(Target, Reason Focus Is Changing, In All Users)
functions.docs: An event should return a FReply::Handled().ClearUserFocus() to ask the system to clear user focus

functions.name: CancelFocusRequest
functions.docs:
An event should rarely invoke FReply::CancelFocusRequest. This will change the reply
so that it no longer contains a request for the system to set or clear focus.
This is most useful when a reply has been cached for use in async operations.

functions.name: SetNavigation
functions.signature: SetNavigation(Target, In Navigation Type, In Navigation Genesis, In Navigation Source)
functions.docs: An event should return FReply::Handled().SetNavigation( NavigationType ) as a means of asking the system to attempt a navigation

functions.name: SetNavigation
functions.signature: SetNavigation(Target, In Navigation Destination, In Navigation Genesis, In Navigation Source)
functions.docs: An event should return FReply::Handled().SetNavigation( NavigationDestination ) as a means of asking the system to attempt a navigation to the specified destination

functions.name: LockMouseToWidget
functions.docs:
An event should return FReply::Handled().LockMouseToWidget( SomeWidget ) as a means of asking the system to
Lock the mouse so it cannot move out of the bounds of the widget.

functions.name: ReleaseMouseLock
functions.docs: An event should return a FReply::Handled().ReleaseMouseLock() to ask the system to release mouse lock on a widget

functions.name: ReleaseMouseCapture
functions.docs:
An event should return a FReply::Handled().ReleaseMouse() to ask the system to release mouse capture
NOTE: Deactivates high precision mouse movement if activated.

functions.name: DetectDrag
functions.signature: DetectDrag(Target, Detect Drag In Me, Mouse Button)

functions.name: BeginDragDrop
EndDragDrop
functions.docs: An event should return FReply::Handled().EndDragDrop() to request that the current drag/drop operation be terminated.

functions.name: PreventThrottling
functions.docs: Ensures throttling for Slate UI responsiveness is not done on mouse down

functions.name: ShouldReleaseMouse
functions.docs: True if this reply indicated that we should release mouse capture as a result of the event being handled

functions.name: ShouldSetUserFocus
functions.docs: true if this reply indicated that we should set focus as a result of the event being handled

functions.name: ShouldReleaseUserFocus
functions.docs: true if this reply indicated that we should release focus as a result of the event being handled

functions.name: AffectsAllUsers
functions.docs: If the event replied with a request to change the user focus whether it should do it for all users or just the current UserIndex

functions.name: ShouldUseHighPrecisionMouse
functions.docs: True if this reply indicated that we should use high precision mouse movement

functions.name: ShouldReleaseMouseLock
functions.docs: True if the reply indicated that we should release mouse lock

functions.name: ShouldThrottle
functions.docs: Whether or not we should throttle on mouse down

functions.name: GetMouseLockWidget
functions.docs: Returns the widget that the mouse should be locked to (if any)

functions.name: GetUserFocusRecepient
functions.docs: When not nullptr, user focus has been requested to be set on the FocusRecipient.

functions.name: GetFocusCause
functions.docs: Get the reason that a focus change is being requested.

functions.name: GetMouseCaptor
functions.docs: If the event replied with a request to capture the mouse, this returns the desired mouse captor. Otherwise returns an invalid pointer.

functions.name: GetNavigationType
functions.docs: Get the navigation type (Invalid if no navigation is requested).

functions.name: GetNavigationGenesis
functions.docs: Get the genesis of the navigation.

functions.name: GetNavigationSource
functions.docs: Get the source of the navigation.

functions.name: GetNavigationDestination
functions.docs: Get the widget that is the navigation destination.

functions.name: GetDragDropContent
functions.docs: @return the Content that we should use for the Drag and Drop operation; Invalid SharedPtr if a drag and drop operation is not requested

functions.name: ShouldEndDragDrop
functions.docs: @return true if the user has asked us to terminate the ongoing drag/drop operation

functions.name: GetDetectDragRequest
functions.docs: @return a widget for which to detect a drag; Invalid SharedPtr if no drag detection requested

functions.name: GetDetectDragRequestButton
functions.docs: @return the mouse button for which we are detecting a drag

functions.name: GetRequestedMousePos
functions.docs: @return The coordinates of the requested mouse position

functions.name: ToString
functions.docs: Converts the reply into an string representation.

functions.name: Handled
functions.docs: An event should return a FReply::Handled() to let the system know that an event was handled.

functions.name: Unhandled
functions.docs: An event should return a FReply::Unhandled() to let the system know that an event was unhandled.
